Twelve (twelve.co; formerly Opus 12), Berkeley, CA; electrochemical CO2-to-fuels/chemicals ('the carbon transformation company'), building AirPlant One e-SAF plant in Moses Lake, WA. Series A $57M (Jul 2021), Series B $130M (Jun 2022, DCVC), Series C $200M (Sep 2024, TPG/Capricorn/Pulse Fund) as part of a $645M package that also included $400M project-level equity led by TPG Rise Climate and $45M loans (both excluded from corporate equity total). ~$11M seed (2019) appears only on trackers, excluded. Earlier government research grants as Opus 12 not itemized. Sum of corporate rounds $387M. Private.
